module "TruncationFit.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiTruncation" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 0.5, 0.25, 1), ParameterName="Tint", SortPriority=32) : float4 @L9:C9 "Tint"
  %1 = Swizzle(%0, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L21:C14 "Narrow"
  %2 = Custom[Luma](colour=%1, Code="// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/TruncationFit.dsm\n// DreamShader custom: Luma line 3\n return dot(colour, float3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); \n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/Legacy/IR/Rules/TruncationFit.dsm\n", Description="Luma", OutputType="Float1") : [Result:float] @L23:C17 "Alpha"
  %3 = Multiply(%1, %1) : float3 @L24:C17 "Color"
  %4 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%3, Opacity=%2) @L5:C1
  sink %4
